reason: The hand-DMing grind is real, but $147 is three or four times what other DM tools charge and there isn't a single customer result to back it up. I'm not putting a card down for a tool nobody has proven yet.
objection: No proof it books calls, and it costs way more than the other DM tools I've seen. Three days isn't enough to see replies from cold DMs, and after day 4 payments are final.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from a few coaches or agency owners like me (replies and booked calls, not just DMs sent), or a longer trial or a money-back window instead of 'payments are final'.
